summary: The diff partially implements an in-app pending pairing concept (new pendingPairings state + migration scaffolding, parent dashboard alert, and child-side “pending” polling), but key backend data/authorization requirements and parts of the frontend request/confirmation flow are not evidenced in the provided diff summary. The diff also includes numerous unrelated UI/translation/polling changes not requested.

missing_requirements.requirement: Store a pending confirmation request tied to (parentId, childId, phoneNumber, createdAt, status) when child submits a phone number that matches a parent; and block completion until parent confirms.
missing_requirements.reason: Pending request type shown only includes {id,parent,child,pending:Bool} with no phoneNumber, createdAt, or explicit status beyond a boolean; no evidence that phone-based pairing is blocked pending confirmation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes actor methods for (a) create request (child), (b) list pending requests for current parent, (c) confirm a specific request (parent).
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary shows new frontend hooks (names referenced) and new pendingPairings state, but does not include any concrete actor method definitions/signatures in backend/main.mo (file is truncated before any relevant methods are shown).

missing_requirements.requirement: Only addressed parent (and admins if applicable) can view/act on the request; other users cannot read/confirm it.
missing_requirements.reason: No access-control logic for listing/confirming pending requests is shown in the provided backend diff excerpt; cannot verify restriction enforcement from the truncated summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Confirming a request creates the parent-child link, marks the request confirmed/closed, and records an audit log entry for traceability.
missing_requirements.reason: Although new audit log action types (#pendingRequestInitiated/#pendingRequestCompleted) appear in types, there is no visible implementation showing that confirmation mutates links, closes the request, and appends an audit entry.

missing_requirements.requirement: All new user-facing text is in English and wired through existing i18n system (update English dictionary at minimum).
missing_requirements.reason: ParentDashboard uses new i18n keys (e.g., pendingPairingAlertTitle/Description/Confirming/ConfirmButton), but the diff excerpt of en.ts does not show these keys being added (file content shown is truncated and does not evidence the new entries).

missing_requirements.requirement: Child phone pairing flow should create a pending confirmation request and show “pending parent confirmation” state; should not require SMS/OTP entry for this flow.
missing_requirements.reason: PairWithParentCard introduces a 'pending' step and polls useGetMyParent, but the diff excerpt does not show that submitting a phone number triggers creation of a pending request (vs initiating an OTP/verification flow) nor that OTP entry is removed/unused; code is truncated around result handling and the mutation still references usePairWithParentViaPhone.

missing_requirements.requirement: React Query hooks in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts support creating the request, fetching pending status (as needed), and confirming requests; and correctly invalidate ['myParent'] and ['myChildren'] after confirmation.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary mentions new hooks for pending pairing requests and accept mutation, but the provided useQueries.ts excerpt does not show these hook implementations nor their invalidation behavior (file truncated before new hooks).

hallucinated_features.description: Broad app-wide theme/token styling refactors and UI/UX changes unrelated to pending phone confirmation (e.g., App.tsx theme-token styling, login button styling changes, footer/header changes).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by REQ-1/2/3; these changes go beyond the in-app parent confirmation flow.

hallucinated_features.description: Large-scale translation/i18n rewrites across unrelated pages (AdminPanel, TransparencyPolicies) and additional Portuguese support work not scoped to the pending pairing feature.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only requires new text for this feature be in English via i18n; it does not request full translation coverage refactors across the app.

hallucinated_features.description: Added/changed polling behavior for activities, location views, child summary cards, and other monitoring components unrelated to pairing confirmation.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not part of REQ-1/2/3; introduces additional automatic refetch behavior beyond the requested pending confirmation polling.

hallucinated_features.description: Changes to child check-in/live location sharing messaging and capability detection unrelated to phone pairing confirmation.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested; BuildRequest explicitly focuses on in-app parent confirmation for phone-based linking.
